limits: Passing tests and diagnostics do not establish production readiness, specification completeness, world leadership or broad superiority over tonic/prost.
Allocation bytes are cumulative requested bytes under N/2N subtraction; they are not retained capacity, live heap, RSS or peak memory.

Context switches and coarse process CPU ticks are scheduling observations; all higher-cost rows remain visible without becoming speed rankings.

All available higher-cost groups are retained in highlights; missing/partial counter groups remain in referenced complete summaries.
Synthetic payloads, fixed message counts and selected load/transport scopes do not replace complete production workloads or a dedicated-host latency/goodput matrix.
The older C8 resource day is separate. A new C11 pbrs-fixture day still does not provide 24-hour Prost-cache qualification.
The failed C10 workspace and first C11 focused attempt remain failures at their actual source; later passes do not rewrite that history.

The original C11 negative-control controller and pipeline remain FAILED because the owner-unit matcher expected a later assertion. Read-only adjudication preserves that false disposition and validates the actual earlier ownership assertion plus the other negatives and restored positive proof.
